evaluator_predicate.evaluator_predicate_description: The evaluator reported that a spam message was found; it did not test whether the relevant open Data Scientist SMS was located and correctly identified.

evaluator_revealed_alternatives.description: The evaluator directly reported finding a spam message, independently establishing failure of the task's spam-removal requirement.

chains.rationale: The frozen locate-and-identify predicate was satisfied after the scrolling loop was interrupted and the RECRUITER Data Scientist message was opened. The evaluator instead reported finding a spam message, so it does not align with the recovered predicate. The evaluator-revealed spam defect and the frozen competing defects provide independent failure paths; a recovered chain cannot receive a plausible or strong contribution label.
